Class TierList

java.lang.Object
model.TierList
public class TierList extends Object
A class representing the concept of tier list. Container of a Map with keys: TierHeader and values: ElementCollection

  • Constructor Details

    • TierList

      public TierList(String name, ElementCollection unranked)
      Constructs TierList instance. The instance will be constructed with a name and the given Elements to rank; It's initial 'ranked' contents will be set to empty.
      Parameters:
      name - the tier list's name
      unranked - elements to rank
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if name is blank

    • TierList

      public TierList(ElementCollection unranked)
      Constructs a TierList instance. The instance will be constructed with the given Elements to rank; The name will be set to DEFAULT_TIERLIST_NAME; It's initial 'ranked' contents will be set to empty
      Parameters:
      unranked - elements to rank

    • TierList

      public TierList()
      Constructs an empty TierList instance. The name will be set to DEFAULT_TIERLIST_NAME; It's initial contents will be set to empty; Elements to rank will be set to empty

    • TierList

      public TierList(String name, ElementCollection unranked, List<TierHeader> headers, List<ElementCollection> tierListRows)
      Constructs a TierList instance. The tier list instance will be constructed with the given Lists of headers and ElementCollections.
      Parameters:
      name - the tier list's name
      unranked - elements to rank
      headers - List of TierHeader
      tierListRows - List of ElementCollection representing the tier list's rows
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if name is blank
      IllegalArgumentException - if the size of the headers list is smaller than rows list's
